question: What understanding has been gained through the lord of Kaulas' grace?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Knowledge arose by that lord's grace
The known object is the determination of Kaula
inference: Therefore the speaker claims to have known the determination of Kaula through the lord's grace.
plain_english: O lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
